objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Send the REST showcase an XML body it deserializes, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The REST plugin picks a handler from the Content-Type. Read the S2-052 advisory on what reads XML bodies.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework serves the REST showcase? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the component
steps.prompt: Which XML library deserializes the request body? (library name)
